oauth2.scope: openid profile email offline_access accounting.contacts accounting.invoices accounting.payments accounting.banktransactions accounting.manualjournals accounting.reports.aged.read accounting.reports.balancesheet.read accounting.reports.banksummary.read accounting.reports.executivesummary.read accounting.reports.profitandloss.read accounting.reports.taxreports.read accounting.reports.trialbalance.read accounting.budgets.read accounting.attachments accounting.settings projects

xero_create_contact.label: Create or Update Contact

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: ID of the contact to create invoice for.

xero_create_invoice.label: Create or Update Invoice

line_item.label: Line Item
line_item.description: One invoice line as key/value pairs, e.g. Description, Quantity, UnitAmount, AccountCode (such as 200 for Sales) and TaxType. Use List Accounts and List Tax Rates to find valid codes.

date.label: Date Prepared
date.description: Date the invoice was created. Format example: 2019-03-11

due_date.label: Due Date
due_date.description: Due date of the invoice. Format example: 2019-03-11

xero_create_bank_transfer.label: Create Bank Transfer
xero_create_bank_transfer.description: Transfers money between two bank accounts in Xero.

from_bank_account_id.label: From Bank Account
from_bank_account_id.description: The bank account the money leaves.

to_bank_account_id.label: To Bank Account
to_bank_account_id.description: The bank account the money arrives in.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Amount to transfer. Currencies must match between accounts.

date.label: Transfer Date
date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today if not provided.

from_is_reconciled.label: From Is Reconciled
from_is_reconciled.description: Mark source account transaction as reconciled.

to_is_reconciled.label: To Is Reconciled
to_is_reconciled.description: Mark destination account transaction as reconciled.

xero_create_payment.label: Create Payment (Mark Reconciled)
xero_create_payment.description: Applies a payment to an invoice.

invoice_id.label: Invoice (Authorised)
invoice_id.description: Select an authorised invoice (sales or bill) to apply payment to.

xero_create_purchase_order.label: Create Purchase Order with Branding and Arrival Date
xero_create_purchase_order.description: Creates a new purchase order for a contact.

date.label: Date
date.description: Date the purchase order was issued (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

delivery_date.label: Delivery Date
delivery_date.description: Date goods are to be delivered (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

xero_update_purchase_order.label: Update Purchase Order
xero_update_purchase_order.description: Updates details of an existing purchase order.

purchase_order_id.label: Purchase Order
purchase_order_id.description: Select a purchase order to update

xero_add_items_to_sales_invoice.label: Add Items to Existing Sales Invoice
xero_add_items_to_sales_invoice.description: Adds line items to an existing sales invoice (ACCREC).

allow_authorised.label: Allow AUTHORISED invoices
allow_authorised.description: Enable adding items to AUTHORISED invoices (Xero allows limited updates for paid/part-paid ACCREC).

xero_create_credit_note.label: Create Credit Note with Branding Theme
xero_create_credit_note.description: Creates a new credit note for a contact.

date.label: Date
date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today if not provided.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: Add one or more line items. At minimum, each line needs a Description.

xero_create_inventory_item.label: Create Inventory Item
xero_create_inventory_item.description: Creates a new inventory item in Xero.

xero_create_project.label: Create Project
xero_create_project.description: Creates a new project for a contact.

xero_update_sales_invoice.label: Update Sales Invoice
xero_update_sales_invoice.description: Updates details of an existing sales invoice (ACCREC).

allow_authorised.label: Allow AUTHORISED invoices
allow_authorised.description: Enable updates for AUTHORISED invoices (Xero allows limited updates for paid/part-paid ACCREC).

invoice_id.label: Sales Invoice (Editable)
invoice_id.description: Select a sales invoice (ACCREC) with DRAFT or SUBMITTED status.

replace_all_line_items.label: Replace All Line Items
replace_all_line_items.description: If enabled, only the provided line_items will remain. If disabled, we will merge with current lines by updating matching LineItemID and appending new items.

xero_create_repeating_sales_invoice.label: Create Repeating Sales Invoice
xero_create_repeating_sales_invoice.description: Creates a repeating sales invoice (Accounts Receivable).

schedule_period.label: Schedule Period
schedule_period.description: Integer period (e.g., 1 every week, 2 every month).

due_date.label: Due Date (number)
due_date.description: Day number used with due date type (e.g., 20, 31).

due_date_type.label: Due Date Type
due_date_type.description: Weekly schedules take Days After Bill Date or Of Following Month; monthly ones take Of Current Month or Of Following Month.

xero_find_contact.label: Find Contact
xero_find_contact.description: Finds a contact by name or account number (or SearchTerm).

value.label: Value
value.description: Name, Account Number, or Search Term depending on Search By.

summary_only.label: Summary Only (faster, lighter)
summary_only.description: Recommended for broad searches (Search Term). Excludes heavy fields.

xero_find_invoice.label: Find Invoice
xero_find_invoice.description: Finds an invoice by number or reference.

value.label: Value
value.description: Invoice Number, Reference, or Search Term.

xero_find_item.label: Find Item
xero_find_item.description: Finds an item by name or code.

xero_find_purchase_order.label: Find Purchase Order
xero_find_purchase_order.description: Finds a purchase order by given parameters.

value.label: Value
value.description: Number, Reference or ID depending on Search By.

xero_get_invoice_history.label: Get Invoice History
xero_get_invoice_history.description: Returns a list of history records for a given invoice ID.

xero_find_or_create_contact.label: Find or Create Contact
xero_find_or_create_contact.description: Finds or creates a specific contact.
xero_find_or_create_contact.afterResponse:
if ((response.Contacts || []).length > 0) return response;
return call({method: 'POST', url: '/Contacts', headers: {'Xero-Tenant-Id': inputs.tenant_id}, body: {Contacts: [{Name: inputs.name, ...(inputs.email ? {EmailAddress: inputs.email} : {})}]}});

xero_list_organisations.label: List Organisations
xero_list_organisations.description: Lists the Xero organisations this connection can access.

xero_get_organisation.label: Get Organisation Details
xero_get_organisation.description: Gets the settings of a Xero organisation, such as base currency, tax settings and financial year end.

xero_get_invoice.label: Get Invoice
xero_get_invoice.description: Gets one invoice or bill by its ID or invoice number, including line items.

invoice_id.label: Invoice ID or Number
invoice_id.description: The Xero InvoiceID (a GUID) or the invoice number, for example INV-0042.

xero_search_invoices.label: Search Invoices
xero_search_invoices.description: Searches sales invoices and bills by type, status, contact, date range or text, one page at a time.

type.label: Type
type.description: Leave empty to include both sales invoices and bills.

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: Only invoices for this Xero ContactID. Use Find Contact to get it.

search_term.label: Search Term
search_term.description: Matches invoice number and reference (case-insensitive, partial).

summary_only.label: Summary Only
summary_only.description: Leave on for faster results without line items; use Get Invoice for the full invoice.

xero_get_contact.label: Get Contact
xero_get_contact.description: Gets one contact by ID, with addresses and phone numbers.

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: The Xero ContactID (a GUID). Use Find Contact to get it.

xero_archive_contact.label: Archive Contact
xero_archive_contact.description: Archives a contact so it no longer appears in contact lists.

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: The Xero ContactID (a GUID) of the contact to archive.

xero_upsert_item.label: Create or Update Item
xero_upsert_item.description: Creates a product or service item, or updates the item that already has this code.

code.label: Item Code
code.description: Unique code of the item (max 30 characters).

sales_account_code.label: Sales Account Code
sales_account_code.description: Revenue account code, e.g. 200. Use List Accounts to find codes.

sales_tax_type.label: Sales Tax Type
sales_tax_type.description: Tax type from List Tax Rates, e.g. OUTPUT.

purchase_account_code.label: Purchase Account Code
purchase_account_code.description: Expense account code, e.g. 400. Not used for tracked inventory items.

purchase_tax_type.label: Purchase Tax Type
purchase_tax_type.description: Tax type from List Tax Rates, e.g. INPUT.

cogs_account_code.label: COGS Account Code
cogs_account_code.description: Cost of goods sold account code; required for tracked inventory items.

inventory_asset_account_code.label: Inventory Asset Account Code
inventory_asset_account_code.description: Inventory asset account code. Setting it makes the item a tracked inventory item.

xero_search_payments.label: Search Payments
xero_search_payments.description: Searches payments by invoice, status, payment type or date range, one page at a time.

invoice_id.label: Invoice ID
invoice_id.description: Only payments on this Xero InvoiceID (a GUID).

xero_delete_payment.label: Delete Payment
xero_delete_payment.description: Deletes (reverses) a payment so the invoice or bill is unpaid again.

payment_id.label: Payment ID
payment_id.description: The Xero PaymentID (a GUID) to delete.

xero_void_invoice.label: Void or Delete Invoice
xero_void_invoice.description: Voids an approved invoice or bill, or deletes it while it is still a draft or awaiting approval.

invoice_id.label: Invoice ID
invoice_id.description: The Xero InvoiceID (a GUID) or invoice number.

xero_search_bank_transactions.label: Search Bank Transactions
xero_search_bank_transactions.description: Searches spend and receive money transactions by type, status, bank account, contact or date range.

bank_account_id.label: Bank Account ID
bank_account_id.description: Xero AccountID of the bank account (List Accounts).

xero_create_manual_journal.label: Create Manual Journal
xero_create_manual_journal.description: Creates a manual journal with balanced debit and credit lines.

journal_lines.label: Journal Lines
journal_lines.description: JSON array of lines, e.g. [{"LineAmount":100,"AccountCode":"400","Description":"Accrual"},{"LineAmount":-100,"AccountCode":"800"}]. Positive amounts are debits, negative are credits, and the total must be 0. Allowed keys: LineAmount, AccountCode, AccountID, Description, TaxType, TaxAmount, Tracking.

xero_list_accounts.label: List Accounts
xero_list_accounts.description: Lists the chart of accounts, optionally filtered by type, class or status.

payments_enabled_only.label: Only Accounts That Accept Payments
payments_enabled_only.description: Keep only bank accounts and accounts with "Enable payments to this account" on.

xero_list_tax_rates.label: List Tax Rates
xero_list_tax_rates.description: Lists the tax rates of the organisation and the TaxType codes to use on line items.

tax_type.label: Tax Type
tax_type.description: Only the rate with this TaxType code, e.g. OUTPUT.

xero_list_tracking_categories.label: List Tracking Categories
xero_list_tracking_categories.description: Lists tracking categories (such as Region or Department) and their options.

xero_get_profit_and_loss.label: Get Profit and Loss
xero_get_profit_and_loss.description: Runs the Profit and Loss report for a date range, with optional comparison periods.

periods.label: Comparison Periods
periods.description: Number of earlier periods to compare with, 1 to 11.

xero_get_balance_sheet.label: Get Balance Sheet
xero_get_balance_sheet.description: Runs the Balance Sheet report as at a date, with optional comparison periods.

periods.label: Comparison Periods
periods.description: Number of earlier periods to compare with, 1 to 11.

xero_get_bank_summary.label: Get Bank Summary
xero_get_bank_summary.description: Runs the Bank Summary report: opening balance, cash in, cash out and closing balance per bank account.

xero_get_trial_balance.label: Get Trial Balance
xero_get_trial_balance.description: Runs the Trial Balance report as at a date.

xero_get_executive_summary.label: Get Executive Summary
xero_get_executive_summary.description: Runs the Executive Summary report: cash, profitability, balance sheet and performance ratios for a month.

date.label: Month Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
date.description: Any date in the month to report on.

xero_get_aged_receivables.label: Get Aged Receivables for Contact
xero_get_aged_receivables.description: Runs the Aged Receivables report for one customer: what they owe, by invoice and age.

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: The Xero ContactID (a GUID). Use Find Contact to get it.

xero_get_aged_payables.label: Get Aged Payables for Contact
xero_get_aged_payables.description: Runs the Aged Payables report for one supplier: what you owe them, by bill and age.

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: The Xero ContactID (a GUID). Use Find Contact to get it.

xero_create_invoice_ai.label: Create Invoice or Bill
xero_create_invoice_ai.description: Creates a sales invoice or a supplier bill for a contact ID with line items.

tenant_id.label: Organisation ID
tenant_id.description: Xero tenant ID of the organisation to use, from List Organisations. Leave empty when the connection has only one organisation.

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: Xero ContactID (a GUID) of the customer or supplier.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: JSON array of line items, e.g. [{"Description":"Consulting","Quantity":2,"UnitAmount":150.5,"AccountCode":"200","TaxType":"OUTPUT"}]. Each line needs a Description or an ItemCode. Allowed keys: Description, Quantity, UnitAmount, LineAmount, AccountCode, ItemCode, TaxType, TaxAmount, DiscountRate, Tracking (array of {"Name","Option"}), LineItemID. Amounts keep up to 4 decimal places for UnitAmount and Quantity.

date.label: Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
date.description: Invoice date; Xero uses today when empty.

due_date.label: Due Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
due_date.description: Required by Xero before the invoice can be approved.

invoice_number.label: Invoice Number
invoice_number.description: Leave empty to let Xero number sales invoices automatically.

currency_code.label: Currency Code
currency_code.description: ISO code such as USD; defaults to the organisation base currency.

xero_update_invoice_ai.label: Update Invoice or Bill
xero_update_invoice_ai.description: Updates fields or line items of an existing invoice or bill by ID.

tenant_id.label: Organisation ID
tenant_id.description: Xero tenant ID of the organisation to use, from List Organisations. Leave empty when the connection has only one organisation.

invoice_id.label: Invoice ID
invoice_id.description: Xero InvoiceID (a GUID) of the invoice or bill to update.

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: Move the invoice to this ContactID.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: JSON array of line items, e.g. [{"Description":"Consulting","Quantity":2,"UnitAmount":150.5,"AccountCode":"200","TaxType":"OUTPUT"}]. Each line needs a Description or an ItemCode. Allowed keys: Description, Quantity, UnitAmount, LineAmount, AccountCode, ItemCode, TaxType, TaxAmount, DiscountRate, Tracking (array of {"Name","Option"}), LineItemID. Amounts keep up to 4 decimal places for UnitAmount and Quantity.

merge_line_items.label: Merge Line Items
merge_line_items.description: Keep the existing lines, update lines whose LineItemID is given and append new ones. Off replaces all lines.

xero_email_invoice_ai.label: Email Invoice
xero_email_invoice_ai.description: Emails a sales invoice to its contact through Xero.

tenant_id.label: Organisation ID
tenant_id.description: Xero tenant ID of the organisation to use, from List Organisations. Leave empty when the connection has only one organisation.

invoice_id.label: Invoice ID
invoice_id.description: Xero InvoiceID (a GUID) of the sales invoice to email.

xero_email_invoice_ai.afterResponse:
const required = (v, field) => { const t = typeof v === 'string' ? v.trim() : ''; if (!t) throw new Error(field + ' is required.'); return t; };
return {success: true, invoiceId: required(inputs.invoice_id, 'Invoice ID')};

xero_create_payment_ai.label: Record Payment (Account Code, Exchange Rate)
xero_create_payment_ai.description: Records a payment against an approved invoice or bill from a bank account.

tenant_id.label: Organisation ID
tenant_id.description: Xero tenant ID of the organisation to use, from List Organisations. Leave empty when the connection has only one organisation.

invoice_id.label: Invoice ID
invoice_id.description: Xero InvoiceID (a GUID) of the AUTHORISED invoice or bill.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: AccountID of the bank account. Give this or Account Code.

account_code.label: Account Code
account_code.description: Code of the bank account, e.g. 090. Give this or Account ID.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Payment amount in the invoice currency, up to 2 decimal places.

xero_create_credit_note_ai.label: Create Credit Note (Submit for Approval)
xero_create_credit_note_ai.description: Creates a customer or supplier credit note for a contact ID with line items.

tenant_id.label: Organisation ID
tenant_id.description: Xero tenant ID of the organisation to use, from List Organisations. Leave empty when the connection has only one organisation.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: JSON array of line items, e.g. [{"Description":"Consulting","Quantity":2,"UnitAmount":150.5,"AccountCode":"200","TaxType":"OUTPUT"}]. Each line needs a Description or an ItemCode. Allowed keys: Description, Quantity, UnitAmount, LineAmount, AccountCode, ItemCode, TaxType, TaxAmount, DiscountRate, Tracking (array of {"Name","Option"}), LineItemID. Amounts keep up to 4 decimal places for UnitAmount and Quantity.

currency_code.label: Currency Code
currency_code.description: ISO code such as USD; defaults to the organisation base currency.

xero_allocate_credit_note_ai.label: Allocate Credit Note to Invoice
xero_allocate_credit_note_ai.description: Applies part or all of a credit note to an invoice or bill.

tenant_id.label: Organisation ID
tenant_id.description: Xero tenant ID of the organisation to use, from List Organisations. Leave empty when the connection has only one organisation.

invoice_id.label: Invoice ID
invoice_id.description: Xero InvoiceID (a GUID) to apply the credit to.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Amount to allocate, up to 2 decimal places.

xero_create_quote_ai.label: Create Quote
xero_create_quote_ai.description: Creates a quote for a contact ID with line items.

tenant_id.label: Organisation ID
tenant_id.description: Xero tenant ID of the organisation to use, from List Organisations. Leave empty when the connection has only one organisation.

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: Xero ContactID (a GUID) of the customer.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: JSON array of line items, e.g. [{"Description":"Consulting","Quantity":2,"UnitAmount":150.5,"AccountCode":"200","TaxType":"OUTPUT"}]. Each line needs a Description or an ItemCode. Allowed keys: Description, Quantity, UnitAmount, LineAmount, AccountCode, ItemCode, TaxType, TaxAmount, DiscountRate, Tracking (array of {"Name","Option"}), LineItemID. Amounts keep up to 4 decimal places for UnitAmount and Quantity.

currency_code.label: Currency Code
currency_code.description: ISO code such as USD; defaults to the organisation base currency.

xero_create_purchase_order_ai.label: Create Purchase Order (Several Lines, Currency)
xero_create_purchase_order_ai.description: Creates a purchase order to a supplier contact ID with line items.

tenant_id.label: Organisation ID
tenant_id.description: Xero tenant ID of the organisation to use, from List Organisations. Leave empty when the connection has only one organisation.

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: Xero ContactID (a GUID) of the supplier.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: JSON array of line items, e.g. [{"Description":"Consulting","Quantity":2,"UnitAmount":150.5,"AccountCode":"200","TaxType":"OUTPUT"}]. Each line needs a Description or an ItemCode. Allowed keys: Description, Quantity, UnitAmount, LineAmount, AccountCode, ItemCode, TaxType, TaxAmount, DiscountRate, Tracking (array of {"Name","Option"}), LineItemID. Amounts keep up to 4 decimal places for UnitAmount and Quantity.

currency_code.label: Currency Code
currency_code.description: ISO code such as USD; defaults to the organisation base currency.

xero_create_bank_transaction_ai.label: Create Bank Transaction
xero_create_bank_transaction_ai.description: Records a spend money or receive money transaction on a bank account.

tenant_id.label: Organisation ID
tenant_id.description: Xero tenant ID of the organisation to use, from List Organisations. Leave empty when the connection has only one organisation.

bank_account_id.label: Bank Account ID
bank_account_id.description: AccountID of the bank account. Give this or Bank Account Code.

bank_account_code.label: Bank Account Code
bank_account_code.description: Code of the bank account, e.g. 090. Give this or Bank Account ID.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: JSON array of line items, e.g. [{"Description":"Consulting","Quantity":2,"UnitAmount":150.5,"AccountCode":"200","TaxType":"OUTPUT"}]. Each line needs a Description or an ItemCode. Allowed keys: Description, Quantity, UnitAmount, LineAmount, AccountCode, ItemCode, TaxType, TaxAmount, DiscountRate, Tracking (array of {"Name","Option"}), LineItemID. Amounts keep up to 4 decimal places for UnitAmount and Quantity.

currency_code.description: ISO code such as USD; defaults to the organisation base currency.
